correctness.rationale: The self-contained finite verifier exhaustively checks 130 matching faces, 62 Morse pairs and their acyclicity, signed traces of the eight dihedral actions, 284 quotient cells with exact boundary identities, and mod-two ranks (19,68,54). Separate Armstrong, group-coinvariant averaging, universal-coefficient, Hurewicz and Whitehead arguments establish the claimed integral homotopy type. The parameter domain is one precisely defined grid and one full group action.

value.rationale: The smallest square-grid case whose matching complex is simply connected and nontrivial has full D4 symmetry, motivating its natural orbit homotopy type. This exact integral quotient classification establishes a genuine two-sphere surviving from five source spheres and excludes otherwise invisible quotient torsion and fundamental-group obstructions.
